params.name: EnRstChks
comment: Enable reset-related assertion checks, disabled by default.

params.name: EnRzHs
comment: By Default, the faster NRZ handshake protocol
(EnRzHs = 0) is used. Enable the RZ handshake protocol
if the FSMs need to be partial-reset-safe.

ports.name: req_chk_i
comment: Used for gating assertions. Drive to 1 during normal operation.
